properties.site-address: Slate Hall Farm, North Lane, North Sunderland
properties.notes: Range of vacant agricultural buildings, situated within the settlement in an established residential area, that offer scope for redevelopment. Planning permission in place for a development of 6 homes (15/02434/FUL). However development is yet to commence and it is anticipated that it is more likely to come forward in the medium- to longer-term and not immediately.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
